newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Golden State target upped.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Golden State target upped.

text.p: Smith Barney said on Monday it was raising its price target and earnings estimates on the shares of Golden State Bancorp, after Golden State announced the acquisition of CenFed Financial.
-- Analyst Thomas O'Donnell said he was raising his target to $35 from $33 per share.
-- He raised his fiscal 1998 earnings estimate to $1.75 per share from $1.65 per share and his 1999 estimate to $2.30 per share from $2.00 per share.
-- "We view the earnings-accretive deal, in which CenFed shareholders will receive 1.2 Golden State shares for each CenFed share, very favorably," O'Donnell said.
